document_kind: handoff note, not a pre-registration and not an authority
status: NOT STARTED. P-0c is not entered by this invocation.

why_it_is_not_started_here.the_directive_does_say_move_to_P0c: yes, and it states that this does not require further consultation
why_it_is_not_started_here.but: section 8 of the same directive says that when a stop condition fires the response is to stop, commit and report, without self-repair. Two fired
why_it_is_not_started_here.and_the_blocking_reason_is_concrete: P-0c needs an estimand exactly as P-0' did. The estimand is HELD under HB-005, and the agent may not choose one. Starting P-0c would either inherit a criterion already shown to fail case 2, or require the agent to select a replacement, which is the thing reserved for the operator

what_P0c_is.description: train a small transformer on a two-step task with an intermediate defined by us, so ground truth is exact
what_P0c_is.status_in_that_authority: a fallback, explicitly not the main line, because transfer is poor
what_P0c_is.hard_design_constraint_recorded_there: the intermediate must NOT appear in any item's output tokens, or the logit lens reads it directly and J has no room to prove anything

why_n_equals_18_points_at_it.observation: only 18 of 184 admissible pairs have this model correct on both sides
why_n_equals_18_points_at_it.consequence: the multihop set does not supply enough units this model can actually do, and no repair of the instrument changes that
why_n_equals_18_points_at_it.what_P0c_fixes: it removes the dependence on a model happening to be able to do a set of items somebody else wrote
why_n_equals_18_points_at_it.what_P0c_does_not_fix: transfer; a result on a small trained transformer is a result about that transformer

what_is_already_fixed_and_should_be_inhe.note: these were registered and pushed before any measurement in P-0', so a successor inherits them rather than choosing them
what_is_already_fixed_and_should_be_inhe.inclusion_correct_only: admissible only if the clean runs are correct on both sides; measured on clean runs, independent of every patching result
what_is_already_fixed_and_should_be_inhe.null_procedure: unrelated-donor, 5 independent replicates, ceiling as the maximum upper bound WITHIN the decisive site rather than across sites
what_is_already_fixed_and_should_be_inhe.bootstrap: cluster bootstrap over unordered pairs, 10000 resamples, seed 20260829
what_is_already_fixed_and_should_be_inhe.the_repaired_harness: the three-part batch fix, verified bit-exact over 190 units in both dtypes

what_P0c_must_settle_before_it_can_start: an estimand that is invariant to a norm-matched destructive patch BY CONSTRUCTION rather than by after-the-fact check; the four synthetic cases exist and will test any candidate without modification
whether the intermediate's absence from every output token is enforced mechanically rather than by inspection, since that is the one constraint the P-0 authority singles out
a positive control for the PHENOMENON, which no phase of this study has ever had; P-0 obtained one for the instrument only

the_four_synthetic_cases_are_reusable_as.how: it takes the estimand as an argument rather than hard-coding one, so a candidate can be tested before it is adopted
the_four_synthetic_cases_are_reusable_as.why_that_matters: an estimand whose discriminating property is only checked once real profiles exist cannot be distinguished from one chosen because those profiles came out well

what_must_not_be_carried_forward: P-0's withheld verdict, which is uninterpretable and may not be cited as a conclusion
any claim about J-space, the J-lens, the published lenses, the paper, or T
any suggestion that EQ1's Q-4a FAIL or EQ2's NEGATIVE has been weakened; neither has been touched
